--- title: Fuel Price Analysis in QLD author: Surya Chandra Rejinthala date: 2026-07-16 categories: [R, 26Winter, "data: qld_fuel.csv"] --- ## Introduction This project analyzes Queensland fuel price data to identify pricing trends across fuel types and time The analysis was conducted using R programming. ## Importing Data and necessary libraries ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} #Importing data fueldata <- read.csv("data/qld_fuel.csv") #Loading packages library(dplyr) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Attaching package: 'dplyr' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` The following objects are masked from 'package:stats': filter, lag ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` The following objects are masked from 'package:base': intersect, setdiff, setequal, union ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} library(lubridate) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Attaching package: 'lubridate' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` The following objects are masked from 'package:base': date, intersect, setdiff, union ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} library(ggplot2) library(plotly) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Attaching package: 'plotly' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` The following object is masked from 'package:ggplot2': last_plot ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` The following object is masked from 'package:stats': filter ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` The following object is masked from 'package:graphics': layout ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} library(ggpubr) ``` ::: ## Overview of Fuel Types and total number of transcations ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fueldata <- fueldata |> select(-X, -X_id) #removing X and X_id column #converting date from str to date date <- fueldata$TransactionDateutc date <- ymd_hms(date) #unique Fueltypes or types of fuels unique(fueldata$Fuel_Type) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "Diesel" "PULP 98 RON" "Unleaded" "e10" [5] "LPG" "Premium Diesel" "PULP 95/96 RON" "e85" [9] "OPAL" ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggplot(fueldata, aes(y= Fuel_Type))+ geom_bar(fill = "blue")+theme_minimal() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Report_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Top 5 Fuel Brands Available Fuel Brands in QLD and the Top 5 fuel brands with the highest number of transcations over the year are. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} #fuel Companies unique(fueldata$Site_Brand) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "Liberty" "BP" "7 Eleven" [4] "EG Ampol" "Coles Express" "Ampol" [7] "Caltex" "Freedom Fuels" "Metro Fuel" [10] "Pearl Energy" "Independent" "Shell" [13] "Puma Energy" "United" "Pacific Petroleum" [16] "Mobil" "Pacific Fuel Solutio" "Matilda" [19] "Enhance" "Astron" "Lowes" [22] "IOR Petroleum" "Unknown" "Choice" [25] "Costco" ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} #Top 5 brands top5 <- fueldata |> count(Site_Brand, sort= TRUE) |> head(n = 5) print(top5) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Site_Brand n 1 7 Eleven 118040 2 Ampol 105750 3 BP 84121 4 Coles Express 71882 5 EG Ampol 62774 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggplot(top5,aes(x=Site_Brand, y=n))+geom_col(fill= "light green")+theme_minimal() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Report_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Summary of Fuel Price ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} summary(fueldata$Price) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Min. 1st Qu. Median Mean 3rd Qu. Max. 1 1869 1999 2005 2139 9000 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} mean(fueldata$Price) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 2005.467 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} median(fueldata$Price) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 1999 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} sd(fueldata$Price) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 203.584 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} #Histogram of data ggplot(fueldata, aes(Price))+ geom_histogram(fill="orange", bins=40)+ theme_minimal() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Report_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Fuel types and Prices All fuel types does not cost similar price at any given time as many differnt factors account for the pricing. For example, LPG is one of cheapest fuel while PULP 98 is the expensive fuel type. Average pricing of all fuel types. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} #Fuel prices by fuel type ggplot(fueldata, aes(x=Fuel_Type, y=Price, fill=Fuel_Type))+ geom_boxplot()+ theme_minimal()+ coord_flip() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Report_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### Trend of FUEL Price by month ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # monthly prices fueldata <- fueldata |> # update data with the new column month mutate(month = month(date)) monthly <- fueldata |> group_by(month, Fuel_Type, colour=Fuel_Type) |> summarise( AveragePrice=mean(Price) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` `summarise()` has grouped output by 'month', 'Fuel_Type'. You can override using the `.groups` argument. ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ggplot(monthly, aes(month, AveragePrice, ))+ geom_point(aes(colour=Fuel_Type))+ geom_smooth()+ theme_classic() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` `geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess' and formula = 'y ~ x' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Report_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Making interactive ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} my_plot <- ggplot(monthly, aes(month, AveragePrice, colour= Fuel_Type, frame= month))+ #geom_line(color="blue")+ geom_point()+ theme_minimal() ggplotly(my_plot) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
